styles.label: Claymorphism
styles.description: Molded, tactile, sculpted surfaces with dual inner-shadow volumetric depth and friendly physical presence.
styles.recommended_for: Playful consumer experiences, creative tools, personal dashboards, and tactile web apps.

styles.label: Glassmorphism
styles.description: Recognizable frosted, translucent panes filtering layered ambient light, in light or dark glass themes.
styles.recommended_for: Marketing microsites, media interfaces, hero sections and light dashboards.

styles.label: Brutalism
styles.description: Raw structural honesty, exposed layout scaffolding, unapologetic monochrome contrast, and zero cosmetic camouflage. Includes Raw Brutalism and Brutalist Bento layout variants.
styles.recommended_for: Experimental portfolios, art/culture, activist/editorial sites, distinctive landing pages, and modular architectural showcases.

variants.label: Raw Brutalism
variants.description: Exposed structural scaffolding, stark monochrome authority, 0px square corners, and immediate state transitions.

variants.label: Brutalist Bento
variants.description: Modular asymmetric grid composition with varied panel spans locked inside uncompromising brutalist structural borders.

styles.label: Neo-brutalism
styles.description: Playful bold colors, high-contrast black borders, hard unblurred offset shadows, and tactile mechanical press feedback.
styles.recommended_for: Creator tools, playful SaaS, event or indie product websites.

styles.label: Minimalism / Enterprise Data-first
styles.description: Purposeful restraint, active intentional negative space, mathematical typography, hairline dividers, and high-density operational data cockpits.
styles.recommended_for: Productivity tools, developer consoles, B2B SaaS platforms, operational dashboards, storefronts, and form-centric workflows.

styles.label: Swiss / Editorial
styles.description: Rigorous grid-driven typographic hierarchy, stark scale contrast, structural hairline rules, and intentional negative space.
styles.recommended_for: Magazines, agencies, portfolios, reports and information-rich marketing sites.

styles.label: Skeuomorphism
styles.description: Digital controls borrow tangible affordances from physical objects, industrial machinery, and analog hardware.
styles.recommended_for: Music tools, specialized controls, educational simulations and playful product interfaces.

styles.label: Retro Terminal
styles.description: Authentic CRT developer-console visual language, phosphor glow, monospace tabular structure, and modern keyboard-driven utility.
styles.recommended_for: Developer portfolios, CLI dashboards, cyberculture experiences and coding tools.

styles.label: Retro Pixel
styles.description: Nostalgic 8-bit and 16-bit computing culture with integer-aligned pixel art, classic desktop window chrome, stepped pixel borders, and arcade accents.
styles.recommended_for: Gaming platforms, retro portfolios, creative developer tools, interactive web apps, and indie products.

styles.label: Art Deco
styles.description: Architectural geometric precision, stepped chevron forms, elegant symmetry, refined typography, and disciplined ornamentation. Features Modern Deco, Classic Deco, and Minimal Deco expressions.
styles.recommended_for: Luxury brands, cultural institutions, architecture & interior studios, editorial publications, premium hospitality, and sophisticated SaaS.

variants.label: Modern Deco
variants.description: Contemporary architectural refinement, generous whitespace, simplified geometric motifs, and modern grid discipline.

variants.label: Classic Deco
variants.description: Rich dramatic sophistication, stepped architectural framing, high-contrast typography, and antique gold accents.

variants.label: Minimal Deco
variants.description: Quiet sophistication, bronze and burgundy accents, clean architectural composition, and spacious modern layouts.
